rationale: After breaking out to a new session high of $12.71, LION pulled back cleanly on low volume and found support exactly at the rising 5-minute 9-EMA ($12.54) while remaining well above session VWAP ($12.51). The most recent 1-minute candles show buyers stepping back in on nearly 5x the pullback volume to form higher lows and push the price back to $12.59 as relative volume expands to 3.78x. With the intraday uptrend intact and invalidation protected at $12.46, holding for a retest of the highs and continuation toward the $12.85 target remains the highest-expectancy play.
